note: Surface forms that count as a name for one entity when written with a capital, for names the lemmatizer cannot reach (it leaves an inflected name as its own lemma, or sends it to a common word). Forms are Latin and are listed as the corpus writes them, each attested capitalized in the counted windows. The lemma table is not changed. Stage 1c, 2026-10-17.

overrides.label: Placentia
overrides.evidence: Placentia is lemmatized to placeo; Placentiam (Livy 21-30, window 210).

overrides.label: Fulginiae
overrides.evidence: Fulginis is lemmatized to fulgo (Itinerarium Hierosolymitanum, window 540).

overrides.label: Atalanta
overrides.evidence: Atalantes is its own lemma, not atalanta (Ovid Amores 3, window 96).

overrides.label: Thermopylae
overrides.evidence: Thermopylas is its own lemma, Thermopylarum goes to thermopylaris (Livy 31-40, window 1032).

overrides.label: Venafrum
overrides.evidence: Venafro is lemmatized to uenafro, never to the entity's lemma (Silius Punica 8, window 402).

overrides.label: Europos/Euromos
overrides.evidence: Euromo is its own lemma and the entity's form Eurome is never capitalized in the corpus (Livy 31-40, window 1344).

overrides.label: Acragas
overrides.evidence: Agrigenti and Agrigentum are their own lemmas (Cicero In Verrem, window 158).

overrides.label: Libya/Africa
overrides.evidence: Libye is its own lemma (Martial 9, window 468).
